versions.localizedDescription: GoldenNugget Mobile 9.7.6 from the soum91 fork. Fixes the .batter template import file picker by using a single document importer, supporting generic Files items, and registering the .batter document type.
versions.changelog: Fix .batter file selection in Templates and Community Catalog, avoid conflicting SwiftUI file importers, and register .batter UTI.

versions.localizedDescription: GoldenNugget Mobile runs on-device customization and partial restore workflows for iOS 26 and 27. This 9.7.5 IPA is the official upstream release. The fork's 9.7.6 .batter file-picker fix is in source code only and is not included in this download yet. Back up the device before applying tweaks.
versions.changelog: Official upstream 9.7.5: separate Select Pairing File and Pair Wirelessly controls so neither triggers the other. Does not include the fork's later .batter picker fix.
